setup_multiprocessing_fork: setup multi-processing start method to fork for faster PyTorch training on Linux
setup_opencv_threads: disable OpenCV multithreading by setting thread count to zero via config
setup_omp_threads: set OMP_NUM_THREADS environment variable to 1 to avoid system overload during training
setup_mkl_threads: set MKL_NUM_THREADS environment variable to 1 to prevent system overload with multiple workers
review_setup_multi_processes: review the setup_multi_processes function to understand how it configures multiprocessing and thread environment variables
